d: Bihar men bidupur pul ka nam purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke nam par rakhe jane ko lekar bihar vidhanasbha men vipaksh ke neta tejasvi yadav dvara die gae bayan par mantri ram kripal yadav ne pratikriya di hai. midiya se batchit karte hue mantri ram kripal yadav ne neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ke bayan par saval uthate hue is pariyojna ki shuruaat ka ullekh kiya hai.
